# `runProvidedContextToRunWith`

Suggests Effect.run*With instead of running an effect provided with Effect.provideContext or Effect.setContext

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377166` |
| Language Service name | `runProvidedContextToRunWith` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/run-provided-context-to-run-with` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Context, Effect } from "effect"

declare const program: Effect.Effect<string, never, "Config">
declare const services: Context.Context<"Config">

export const result = Effect.runPromise(Effect.provideContext(program, services))
/**
                      ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(run-provided-context-to-run-with): `Effect.runPromise` of `Effect.provideContext` re-implements `Effect.runPromiseWith`. Use `Effect.runPromiseWith(context)(effect)` to run the effect with the context directly.
*/
```
